crossRefs.note: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go…

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
translations.bsb: Then Jonathan said to David, “Tomorrow is the New Moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
translations.kjv: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
translations.asv: Then Jonathan said unto him, To-morrow is the new moon: and thou wilt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
